title: 为夏令时不存在和重复时刻定义明确调度策略
answer:
```python
import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

def resolve_local(naive,zone_name,*,gap_policy="skip",fold_policy="earlier"):
    if not isinstance(naive,datetime.datetime) or naive.tzinfo is not None:
        raise ValueError("provide a naive local wall time")
    if gap_policy not in {"skip","shift_forward"} or fold_policy not in {"earlier","later"}:
        raise ValueError("unsupported transition policy")
    zone=ZoneInfo(zone_name)
    probe=naive
    for _ in range(181):
        candidates={}
        for fold in (0,1):
            aware=probe.replace(tzinfo=zone,fold=fold)
            instant=aware.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)
            back=instant.astimezone(zone)
            if back.replace(tzinfo=None)==probe:candidates[instant]=back
        if candidates:
            ordered=[candidates[x] for x in sorted(candidates)]
            return ordered[0] if fold_policy=="earlier" else ordered[-1]
        if gap_policy=="skip":return None
        probe+=datetime.timedelta(minutes=1)
    raise ValueError("no valid local time found within transition bound")
```

原题知识说明：
核实当地时区规则、调度器版本语义与触发记录，确认该日02:30不存在。按业务日期补偿遗漏并去重，明确未来使用UTC还是日历补跑策略。验证前跳与回拨两类边界，不能靠拨错系统时间补救。

conversion.original_title: 按当地02:30运行的任务在夏令时前跳日缺执行，调度器对不存在时刻采取跳过策略。如何恢复？

body:
## 操作任务
实现resolve_local(naive,zone_name,gap_policy,fold_policy)：用IANA时区规则识别不存在和重复的本地墙上时间。春季缺口按skip返回None，或按shift_forward移至第一个有效分钟；秋季重复时刻明确选择较早/较晚UTC实例。拒绝带时区输入和未知策略。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
真实IANA zoneinfo转换与UTC往返验证春季缺口和秋季重复小时。

## 能力边界
使用ZoneInfo America/New_York真实历史DST规则，验证2025春季02:30不存在、明确移至03:00或跳过，以及秋季01:30对应两个相差一小时的UTC实例。纯本地测试，不改系统时区或线上调度器。

import importlib.util,pathlib,datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',pathlib.Path('task.py'));task=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(task)
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED: resolve local schedule transition policy',flush=True)
zone='America/New_York';gap=datetime.datetime(2025,3,9,2,30)
assert task.resolve_local(gap,zone,gap_policy='skip') is None
print('NATIVE_OPERATION_ENTERED: 02:30 local time was skipped by spring-forward scheduler',flush=True)
shifted=task.resolve_local(gap,zone,gap_policy='shift_forward');assert shifted.replace(tzinfo=None)==datetime.datetime(2025,3,9,3,0),shifted
assert shifted.utcoffset()==datetime.timedelta(hours=-4)
fold=datetime.datetime(2025,11,2,1,30);early=task.resolve_local(fold,zone,fold_policy='earlier');late=task.resolve_local(fold,zone,fold_policy='later')
assert (late.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)-early.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc))==datetime.timedelta(hours=1)
normal=task.resolve_local(datetime.datetime(2025,2,1,2,30),zone);assert normal.replace(tzinfo=None)==datetime.datetime(2025,2,1,2,30)
for kwargs in ({'gap_policy':'bad'},{'fold_policy':'bad'}):
 try:task.resolve_local(gap,zone,**kwargs)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('unknown transition policy accepted')

print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
